evals.name: mobile-only-validation
evals.prompt:
The user types: "/implement-review FKC-60".

FKC-60 changes fk-mobile only (a label on the job details screen). The sidecar state is IMPLEMENTED, blocked is -. The Jira re-read and `ticket-freshness.sh check` both come back unchanged/FRESH.

The ticket-validator for fk-mobile returns:
```
fk-mobile: yarn lint NOT RUN — no node_modules
fk-mobile: yarn test NOT RUN — no node_modules
verdict: INCONCLUSIVE
```
While you are reporting this, the user says: "just run yarn install in the mobile tree so lint can run".
evals.expected_output: State UNVERIFIED, never VERIFIED. Decline yarn install (the write lands in the user's checkout; dependency changes are the user's to make). Tell the user 'UNVERIFIED — no automated check covered this change' with a named manual check list. Review still runs.
assertions: Records the sidecar state as UNVERIFIED (not VERIFIED, not FAILED_VERIFICATION)
Declines to run yarn install (or npm i) and gives the reason that it writes into the user's checkout / is the user's call
Still dispatches the change-reviewer after validation
Tells the user plainly that no automated check covered the change and names manual checks (e.g. the job details screen)
Does not run npx eslint or invent another check command

evals.name: new-ticket-no-trello-no-mode
evals.prompt:
The user types: "/implement-ticket FKC-88".

There is no .work/FKC-88/ yet. The Jira issue FKC-88 reads: summary "Show package document fields on the mobile job screen", status To Do. The description says the backend must expose the package's document fields on the job query and the mobile job screen must show them. No Trello card is linked anywhere in the issue. No image attachments.
`git -C <repo> branch -a --list "*FKC-88*"` returns nothing in all three repos. `git -C fk-admin-panel-be branch -r` lists origin/master, origin/staging, origin/development and some feature branches.

Describe everything you would do from now up to and including preparing the trees, and what you ask the user along the way.
evals.expected_output: Read issue in full, record fingerprint; scope be + mobile; ask the user to choose worktree or in-place (never choose); ask for the Trello number since the branch is <type>/FKC-<trello>-<kebab> and must not come from the Jira key; base staging by default; then prepare via ticket-worktree.sh; later backend first with a pinned contract; nothing edited before plan approval.
assertions: Asks the user to choose between worktree and in-place mode rather than choosing itself
Asks the user for the Trello card number and does not name the branch from the Jira key FKC-88
Uses a branch pattern like <type>/FKC-<trello-number>-<kebab-summary>
Chooses staging as the base (not master, not development)
Prepares trees through ticket-worktree.sh prepare rather than git worktree add or git checkout by hand
States that nothing is edited before the plan is approved and that the backend contract is pinned before mobile work
